If the screen is stuck on the "Hello" screen, is the touch functionality still operational?

additional_info.subject: RE: 0405392 - ID0405392-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117150] Device is on the Hallo-Hello Screen CRM:00646000019
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I hope all is well with you. The previous site interventions were unavoidable in these troubleshooting steps. As there are no logs or charger connectivity to the SCB backend, we cannot come to a conclusion of either config corruption, Cfast damage, or KF1 fault. In this case, for the first intervention, the HMI was stuck on the Hello-Hello screen, and it is a symptom of config corruption. In order to revive the charger, there is no other option than a site visit to restore the config and CFast card flashing. As there was no spare CF card that time, we were not able to check the healthiness of the CF card and planned another visit to try with a new CF card. The second intervention is that the CFAST card itself is not identified by the PLC, which leads us to suspect the KF1 fault.
Please plan your next site intervention with a spare KF1, Cfast card & router. There is a suggestion from my side to collect dump logs from the charger whenever you are troubleshooting a charger that is offline to SCB. Can you please share the photos of KF1 LED in case if it is available with you?
